description: The template contract: every {{TOKEN}} and kit:if flag a template may use. The render script fills tokens from detect and the owner's answers and fails on any token that is unknown, unfilled or does not match its type. See docs/templates.md in the kit repo.

string.description: One line of prose. No braces, angle brackets or backticks, so a value can't open a token, a tag or a code span.

identifier.description: A name such as a branch prefix or owner/repo. Safe in shell, YAML and Markdown.

path.description: A repo-relative path. No leading slash, no '..'.

command.description: One command line with no shell metacharacters (no quotes, $, ;, |, &, redirects or globs), so it can be matched exactly by a guard.

json-array.description: A JSON array of strings, inserted as a literal. Its name ends in _JSON and it has no twin. Each item must match the token itemPattern. Used only in .mjs and .json templates.

rejectCommandPatterns.description: A value is rejected at render time if any command in it (a command token, an item of VERIFY_COMMANDS_JSON or DB_COMMANDS_JSON, or the command inside a Bash(...) rule) matches one of these. The production list is a backstop (remote hosts, deploy CLIs, connection URLs, push, deploy and release scripts); it is not the classifier, so a match means: ask the owner, never allow. The blockedByGuard list is what bash-guard blocks anyway (inline env assignments, git --output), so such an entry could never run. The first-word patterns also match behind one runner word (for example `npx <tool>` or `<runner> exec <tool>`); deeper wrappers such as `bash -c` are not unwrapped, which the command type's no-quotes rule already blocks. The installed .claude/hooks/guards.test.mjs carries a copy of the production list (minus host names the kit lint keeps out of templates); the kit lint checks the two stay in sync.

OWNER.description: The human who approves plans and merges. No "|", because it appears in Markdown tables.

ENV_PREFIX.description: Prefix of the pre-push override variable, <ENV_PREFIX>_ALLOW_PUSH_MAIN.
ENV_PREFIX.source: derived from PROJECT_NAME, confirmed by the owner

KIT_VERSION.description: The kit version that rendered the files.

CMD_CHECKS.description: The detected check commands (typecheck, lint, test, in that order) joined with ' && '.
CMD_CHECKS.source: derived from CMD_TYPECHECK, CMD_LINT and CMD_TEST
CMD_CHECKS.example: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test

CMD_HOOK_TESTS.description: The command that runs the harness's own script tests (hook guards, skill scripts, git hooks).

DB_PATH.description: The folder holding the schema and migrations, which the architect may edit. No segment may start with a dot, so it can never be the repo root, .git/ or .claude/.

PERSONA_NAME_BUILDER.description: Display name of the main session (the builder).

PERSONA_NAME_ARCHITECT.description: Display name of the architect persona.

PERSONA_NAME_PLANNER.description: Display name of the planner persona.

PERSONA_NAME_REVIEWER.description: Display name of the reviewer persona.

PERSONA_NAME_RETRO.description: Display name of the retro persona.

PERSONA_NAME_RESEARCHER.description: Display name of the researcher persona.

VERIFY_COMMANDS_JSON.description: The exact check commands (CMD_TYPECHECK, CMD_LINT, CMD_TEST that exist, in that order). bash-guard allows each one exactly, for the read-only and architect profiles. May be empty.
VERIFY_COMMANDS_JSON.source: derived from CMD_TYPECHECK, CMD_LINT and CMD_TEST

DB_COMMANDS_JSON.description: The exact local-database commands the architect may run (generate, create a migration without applying it, apply to the local database, seed). Never a command that reaches a deployed database.
DB_COMMANDS_JSON.source: detect, then classified and confirmed by the owner

ALLOW_RULES_JSON.description: permissions.allow entries for .claude/settings.json: git basics plus the local commands in .agents/rules/commands.md. Never a production-reaching command.

GH_REPO.description: The GitHub repo, owner/name, that open-pr opens PRs against.

GH_ACCOUNT.description: The gh account whose token open-pr passes per command (gh auth token --user <account>), so the active account never has to change.

DATE_YM.description: Year and month of the install, for plan file names. The only token allowed in a template path.

RISKY_PATHS_JSON.description: Paths whose change needs a Rollback line in the PR Notes. An entry ending in / is a folder prefix; any other entry is a file name matched at any depth.
RISKY_PATHS_JSON.source: detect (CI workflows, container and deploy files, schema folder), confirmed by the owner

has.db.description: The repo owns a database schema or migrations.

has.ui.description: The project has a user-facing UI.

has.container.description: A container image is the production artifact.

has.checks.description: At least one of has.typecheck, has.lint and has.test.

flow.gitFlow.description: The repo uses Git Flow (a long-lived dev branch promoted to main).
